entries.test: Public Make a Video demonstrations show whether visually sophisticated outputs also contain basic semantic or physical inconsistencies such as those Marcus describes.

entries.test: Public demonstrations and evaluations in the years following October 2022 show whether generative systems continued producing sophisticated outputs with basic commonsense inconsistencies.
entries.note: “Understanding-free” strengthens the source into an absolute claim. The contextual forecast concerns persistence of the illustrated failures, and several years of subsequent evidence are available.
